text: Amazing view, really nice staf, great tea and nice location Beds were a little bit hard. Also really cold and no extra blankets the first day
Clean Near to exhibition center Very noisy in 11 floor because of nightclub Expensive comparing to service Breakfast is expensive

The flat was clean and well equipped. Good location. Easy check in and check out. The host sent helpful tips on attractions in local area. Overall good value for money. Would reccomend. The description was slightly misleading at booking in terms of number of people that could be accommodated. Was under the impression there was a sofa available apart from the double bed. Only 2 chairs and the bed instead which was not ideal as I travelled with my 17 year old son. It would have been also nice to have extra toilet paper, basic kitchen spices like salt and pepper as well as tea and coffee

Very friendly host, let us check in a little earlier, very good communication and easy to get hold of. Location was good. We even managed to park which was a bonus too. Wasn't aware that our private bathroom would be across the landing with a separate key. Not great having to get dressed in middle of night to go to the loo. Could have been a bit cleaner. The bedding and towels were clean and fresh but there were bits on the floor and dead flies in windows. It just needed a bit of a wipe down everywhere and a good hoover. Basic but satisfactory.
location and price bath and bunk bed mattress
A good base for my walks into the city. OK room, good location and good breakfast.
Crowded, convenient, helpful staff. Location and price A bit weary
good cost-benefit. excellent bed linen and towels Cleaning of the common area and corridors. Not very friendly staff
Location was wonderful. The breakfast was good. Wish the hotel had more amenities.

Great location, clean spacious king room and friendly staff. Spacious king room, clean, friendly staff, complimentary slippers and snacks (popcorn, chocolate and water bottles). No heating unit in the room and had to borrow portable heaters from the front desk.
Loved it. Convenient Affordable Hospitality was great There was nothing to dislike
very nice I recommend. it’s super well located and the apartment was very clean ! they only give one pillow per person and a small blanket but we couldn’t find some spear pillows or blanket anywhere.
great views. far walks. nice rooms with great views on the balconies far from other locations
Old, worn but a little charming, has everything you need, cleaned every day. Smooth check-in and check-out. Located within walking distance, 20 minutes to Vienna's attractions.

Staff were very friendly and helpful Hotel is spotless. Breakfast was good with many options Its an alcohol free hotel. Im not sure if that was advertised when i booked but i didnt notice anyway. There is a veg restaurant next door that sells alcohol.but it was full and extremely hot and humid inside when i visited
Rooms are cozy, the bed was super comfortable! The staff by far is the best part of this place! They have great recommendations of places to go and are very accommodating very small elevators
Huge, comfortable room. Service rather slow.
Great view of the ocean from the dining room There really did not seem to be much in the area to do

Very good but a little bit expensive. The room was spacious enough and nice. The bathroom as well. There even was an ironing table and iron in the room, which was very convenient. Location is ok, Rossman and Lidl 2 min walking from the hotel. It takes 25 min by tram to the city center. There were some brochures claiming high level of cleanness of the room, which made me do a double check. And it resulted there was dust on the toilet sink and some other surfaces where it might seem clean because of the color but if you see it closely and touch it, it looked like it had not been cleaned for three days. This was a bit disappointing particularly for the very expensive price of the room. Another thing I didn't like was the two single blankets on the double bed, instead of a single double size blanket. I find this very uncomfortable. And breakfast was not included despite the very high price.

Great location by tram stop and on bus routes. Main attraction was location as it was at the end of the Tram line. There are some small shops which are open till about 9pm but a local one on the same side of the road stays open later. Though on a main road it is not really noisy at night even being at the front. Check in staff friendly and helpful, offering ideas when showing us a map. Air conditioning was not that effective and needed to be kept on sometimes after going to bed and then turning it off during the night.
clean and good location Internet signal was poor
Nice stay for the night a bit expensive for the room and breakfast. We liked the beds .the bathroom. No TV or WiFi on the third floor. The breakfast was a bit expensive
Location, cheap, owner is very friendly Room is clean but there's cockroach. I killed 5 small roaches😂 No complimentary coffee, no microwave or kettle, toiletries in the room

Was Quant, and in Springfield illinois I would stay again. Breakfast was ok. The people were nice. May want to consider changing the orange juice. Location was easy to find, an OK area. Rooms more together with the couple we traveled with. They said there was an adult and child loud arguing for a long period of time at bedtime in their adjoining room.

Best food ever! The offer is not rich, but what is there is excellent! Prices that do not exist anywhere else in the world! Pitta Giroos with chicken for 3.5 euros? Excuse me, but it is something very tasty that you can't find it anywhere! In addition, there is the swimming pool with excellent clear water, rooms with everything you need basically plus air conditioning for 7 euros, everything was ok! is some distance to the beach or to the town center but we rented a scooter and we were everywhere at the same time! :)
Kids are so enjoy. Swimming pool, spacious room Nothing I can think of
Clean, friendly staff. Convenient, clean and affordable. I was traveling with a pet, and there isn't really a good place on or around the hotel to potty your dog.

Great location, clean rooms, very good service, good breakfast variety and offer but very crowded ! Clean, location, breakfast variety, nice decoration Breakfast time was always super full and crowded

Would stay again without hesitation. Exceptional property. Wonderful to be far from tourists. Dinner was exceptional. Remote location was both a blessing and challenge. Would recommend two nights due to time to get out to the property.
Good value for money right at the beach. the location is perfect! it’s right at the beach! And the owner is super friendly and helpful.
Nice break :). Central, clean and tidy it wasn’t anything I didn’t like however, I would say a smart tv would be amazing!

Willing to visit each time I travel in Varanasi. What separates moustache from rest of the dorms in varanasi is it’s common sitting area which is open terrace and ambience is quiet cozy to relax Sometimes people leave the bathroom unclean but since it’s a community space so people are more responsible then hostel

Excellent value for money and quality. It was a pleasure to stay at the hotel, thank you! Clean facilities and rooms; Good food and especially grill; Friendly and polite staff. Poor soundproof; Pebble beach not very close to the hotel; Not a 5 star :) but in any case a good hotel for the price.

Value for money, service are good was disappointed to see that it appears to have not undergone any renovations since 2006 or more. I believe that the hotel is in dire need of more maintenance. As a guest, I was expecting a more comfortable and up-to-date experience, and I hope that the management takes steps to address these issues soon."

Would stay again. had everything we NEEDED. The 1 bedroom we had, on the first floor, was updated. At first, I was scared to book here because it looked like it was stuck in the 1970's. I am happy to report that the beds were comfy, pillows nice, carpet was newer in the rooms. They still have some updates to do in the room but everything was functional. Loved the kitchen and all the pots/pans and utensils available. Love the dishwasher and big fridge. I would stay here again- grocery store is nearby. The breakfast was free. again, FREE so you can make it work or not. Has biscuits, sausage patties, eggs (like you find on cruises), waffles station, basic bread and cereal. The bathroom needs a magic eraser to work on the rust and water stains- the vanity and counters can be updated. they just need a good handyman to use paint and a drill in other spots.

Would stay again. Location Friendly staff Lovely pool Clean, big room Would be good for pool to have adults only time as some kids were in the hot tub etc and it was hard to swim when they were jumping in etc Good to book a slot for the pool as it's small and can get very busy Pool changing rooms very cramped, would be good if room had robes and flipflops to go down to pool in and then shower / change in room after
Needs a little maintenance done in the room. We were in 107. Clean and comfortable room. When the heat came on it was very loud. The sink faucet had a drip.
the rooms are clean and modern pool is nice. staff very helpful low tie at the beach was not pleasant a restaurant would be nice too far and costly to get to town round trip
Near iconic mountain in the west and easy to find. Had everything in kitchen and huge bathroom. Living room was cold as heater was not working.

great hostel. great kitchen. good location. good wifi. good lounge area, upstairs and downstairs. had to pay for linen/sheets, just a dumb concept to hide an extra fee. feels sleazy, especially when you have to make the bed yourself and dump the dirty laundry. would complain about doing either of those, expect that you charge me for it as well. too many passcode changes. just got annoying. if thieves want to steal, those passcode changes aren’t stopping them.
Central location with easy access to the mall and restaurants

Good value for money, super friendly and helpful staff. Great value for money: a mid range hotel for the same price as a hostel private room. Staff are extremely helpful. They let us use the spa showers to freshen up before our night train the day we checked out. Had a decent massage at the spa. The coffee was surprisingly bad at breakfast (but there are tonnes of good options near by).
The room was impeccably clean. The staff is very accommodating. The location is excellent! Walking distance to many historical sites, restaurants, and pubs. Their onsite restaurant is great!

Great stay and value. rooms are clean and updated. breakfast is good with eggs, sausage, cereal, yogurt and waffle maker every morning. the bed was comfortable. plenty of luggage carts in the lobby. very nice…would stay here again. dog was barking in one of the guest rooms for hours.
Location is good. Breakfast is so tasty . Parking.
Good place to stay. Clean and comfortable room. Breakfast in the morning. Easy to find. Good parking. Easy check in. Clean comfortable room.

Very nice accommodation with beautifully clean surroundings. The hotel was quiet and the staff really very nice and helpful. We also liked the very nice outdoor seating areas in the hotel. Breakfast less varied but for that the food was very good quality so also ok. The hotel is far from the sea and the living towns, so if you don't have a car, it can be a bit of a complication. Not a complaint though, you know this about the hotel beforehand. We had a car and therefore it was no problem for us.
Daily continental breakfast was good and room was kept clean. Location is perfect and close to major city attractions.
